text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The newborn's positive Rubella IgM serology, combined with a history of no prenatal care and immunizations, confirms a congenital vertical transmission of the rubella virus. The normal thyroid and other metabolic screens further support this specific viral etiology.
